say:2:1430406101:1.text: We studied the Helthor's statue underground and noticed the evolution of his appearance.
say:2:1430406101:1.source_cn: 我们通过对地下赫托雕像的研究，发现他的形象在不断改变。
say:2:1430406101:1.male: We studied the Helthor's statue underground and noticed the evolution of his appearance.
say:2:1430406101:1.female: We studied the Helthor's statue underground and noticed the evolution of his appearance.

say:3:1430406102:1.text: I believe that by determining the construction dates of the two most contrasting statues, we could estimate the time period of the Ironheart Dominion.
say:3:1430406102:1.source_cn: 我认为如果确定相差最大两座赫托雕像的建成年代，就可以推...
say:3:1430406102:1.male: I believe that by determining the construction dates of the two most contrasting statues, we could estimate the time period of the Ironheart Dominion.
say:3:1430406102:1.female: I believe that by determining the construction dates of the two most contrasting statues, we could estimate the time period of the Ironheart Dominion.

say:4:1430406103:1.text: It will be a monumental breakthrough in archaeology!
say:4:1430406103:1.source_cn: 这一定是考古学又一个伟大的发现！
say:4:1430406103:1.male: It will be a monumental breakthrough in archaeology!
say:4:1430406103:1.female: It will be a monumental breakthrough in archaeology!
